title: Compute a mean after accumulating prices
description: You separate the repeated addition from the calculation that follows the loop.

steps.description: You store the supplied prices and initialize total to zero. total will retain the running sum.
You visit each price and add it to total. Assignment replaces total with the updated sum.

steps.question: Does average change inside the loop or after all prices have been visited?
steps.answer: It is assigned after the loop. The division uses the completed total and len(prices).

steps.description: You divide by the list length and print the result. The recording shows Average price: 1.9.
